notes.title: Map 2: The Demon's Escape
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=N8gNGFYdmzo;full][/previewyoutube]

Map 2 is a "simple" vertical climb in a huge level. It's just you against the elements.
It'll require a slightly different skillset than in the first map, but the grit and will to succeed is still a requirement.

If you've already cleared Map 1 in Power Mode, then get ready for a more "Foddian" challenge!

It also features higher definition textures and new music.

notes.title: Free content update: Map 2 release in July 2022!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=y6GlsO_fEJc;full][/previewyoutube]

The first campaign was a Collect-A-Thon where you could choose your own path and with chill levels.

For the second campaign, we are going for something different: uninterupted foddian climbing.
There's no loading screen, raise your head up and you might see the exit.

But will you have the skill to reach it?

Coming in July 2022

notes.title: JETBOUNCE Competition - Pre-season 1 is Live!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=drLQ3Tz9sfo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Week 1 will start on Monday 11 April 2022.[/h2]
The season will last for 3 weeks.
Everyday, you will gain points based on the rank you hold that day.

[b]1st: 10pts/day
2nd: 9pts/day
[...]
10th: 1pt/day[/b]

[b]Week 2 will start on Monday 18 April 2022. (points 2X)[/b]
Week 3 will start on Monday 18 April 2022. (points 4X)
[b]Final 3 days will start on Friday 22 April 2022. (points 8X)[/b]
The season will end on 25th of April.

[b]You only need to submit your time once, but you can submit a new record to improve your rank.[/b]
So the longer you hold a high rank, the more points you will accumulate over time.

The winners of the season are not the ones with the best time, but the ones who accumulated the most points.
[b]So the earlier you enter the top 10 rank, the sooner you start earning points.[/b]

Rules:
- You need to collect atleast 15 gems in your run. (So no stair-less runs)
- Your time needs to be atleast under 1 hour.
[b]- Submit your speedrun video on our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/nEkFQjfGS2]https://discord.gg/nEkFQjfGS2[/url][/b]
- Your username should show up in the video when you finish the game, above the leaderboard when your time appears
- In your discord message, ping a @Dev , write your Oculus/Steam username + your time. If it gets approved it'll receive a ✅ 
- If there's less than 8 participants by the 25th of April, the competition will be void.

---
[b]1st place: $70
2nd place: $50
3rd place: $30[/b]
With more prizes to be announced!
